description: This file defines the HttpException class within the Slim framework, which extends RuntimeException. It includes properties and methods for handling HTTP exceptions, including associating a server request, and setting/getting a title and description.

classes.name: HttpException
classes.description: A custom exception class for HTTP errors in the Slim framework, facilitating inclusion of request context and additional metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a server request, message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the server request associated with this exception.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the exception.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the exception.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the exception.
